item.title: Proud Sky Blues: “These groups are vital — they make sure you’re never alone”
item.description: Established in the summer of 2023, Proud Sky Blues is Coventry City’s official LGBTQ+ supporters’ group — and lifelong fan Lewis Wale is the driving force behind it. Inspired by the rise of LGBTQ+ fan groups across football, Lewis decided to take matters into his own hands and create a space where LGBTQ+ supporters, allies, and anyone seeking community could feel safe, welcome, and fully themselves. item.title: ‘Unite For Access’ returns for 2026
item.description: The national sports disability charity Level Playing Field has today launched ‘Unite For Access’ 2026, their annual campaign that promotes access and inclusion for fans with a disability. The celebration will run from 28 February to 15 March , with events set to take place across the EFL. During the campaign, Clubs up and down the country will be hosting dedicated matchdays, as well as delivering sessions to educate the local community on the topic.
